fields.description: Used in determining where to get the Width and Height values.

fields.label: Class Layout ID
fields.description: Layout ID linking to AD Internet Layouts

fields.label: Join Field
fields.description:
AD Internet Layouts has a column width field that is MV.  This join field is construction to join with the NAVIGA-Ad Internet Layouts Dataset if you need to bring in Columns.
NOTE: See docs for a different way to do this.

fields.label: Ad Publication Dflt Layout ID
fields.description: The AD Publications default Layout ID.  It is used in the Join Field if the Class Layout ID in empty.
